expense_template_month.name: expense_template_month
expense_template_month.value: ("expense_template"."cadence" <> 'monthly' and "expense_template"."month_of_year" between 1 and 12) or ("expense_template"."cadence" = 'monthly' and "expense_template"."month_of_year" is null)

split_rule_one_scope.name: split_rule_one_scope
split_rule_one_scope.value:
("split_rule"."scope" = 'template' and "split_rule"."template_lineage_id" is not null and "split_rule"."category" is null)
        or ("split_rule"."scope" = 'category' and "split_rule"."template_lineage_id" is null and "split_rule"."category" is not null)
        or ("split_rule"."scope" = 'household' and "split_rule"."template_lineage_id" is null and "split_rule"."category" is null)
